# No technical support

OpenGrid XR is provided as-is. I do not provide technical support and will not answer DMs about it.

If something does not work for you, feel free to clone or fork the repository, open it with your favorite AI coding tool, and ask it to investigate and fix the issue. Review and test the result, then submit a pull request explaining the problem, the fix and your checks.

See the [contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for build instructions and expectations. A response, review or merge is not guaranteed. Donations and affiliate purchases do not include technical support.
